items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Him and old Kanbos could play good.

ctx.x: Those days he played Val Kanbon, did he? Was it Val?
I thought he used to play Val. He could play too. He could play that horn. Him and old Kanbos could play good. Kanbos was a good Val Kanbon player, but
he wasn't good as Joe though. Joe was one of the best in
